title: Trump Signs Proclamation To Make Oval Office A National Monument
summary: On November 5, U.S. President Donald Trump signed a proclamation declaring the White House’s Oval Office and Cabinet Room as a national monument—a designation that protects the spaces from major alterations in the future.
